measurement_window.selection_rule: Product and release pipelines from the first MR !442 product SHA through the successful v2.4.0 tag pipeline, inclusive; coordination-only and unrelated MR pipelines are excluded by commit ancestry and the source-grounded input map.

provenance.raw_snapshot_control: Local-only retention authorized by governor decision 20260723T232534Z-governor-reviewer-b1ds; deletion due 2026-08-31 unless extended.
provenance.api_accounting_note: Collection includes 29 initial requests, three real-pagination privacy-boundary requests, two candidate-window requests, eight include-retried job requests, and one canceled-pipeline metadata request. Operational review includes two exact-head CI polls and ten contribution-auditor requests.

field_definitions.wall_clock_seconds: finished_at minus created_at; primary observable CI latency for these successful pipelines
field_definitions.api_duration_seconds: GitLab pipeline duration field; retained separately because it excludes some wall-clock overhead
field_definitions.job_execution_seconds: sum of non-null duration across all returned jobs; pipelines overlap, so this is not elapsed time
field_definitions.job_queue_seconds: sum of non-null queued_duration across all returned jobs
field_definitions.critical_path_execution_seconds: sum of observed duration for the listed critical-path jobs
field_definitions.critical_path_transition_gap_seconds: sum of wall-clock gaps between consecutive listed critical-path jobs; it is scheduler/stage-transition overhead, not runner queue time
field_definitions.inter_pipeline_gap_seconds: prior pipeline finished_at to next pipeline created_at; it is not attributed to human work without durable endpoints
field_definitions.attempt: One-based attempt index derived by grouping include_retried=true job rows by pipeline ID and job name, then sorting by job ID.
field_definitions.selection_role: Primary product/release pipeline or ancillary review/cancellation evidence; excluded query candidates remain in candidate_ledger.
